subject.title: fix(google-vertex): add Google Vertex AI onboarding wizard, fix ADC auth, add provider docs

question: Should this PR be the landing path for Google Vertex ADC onboarding, permissive auth evidence, default env/model writes, and core fallback routing once the generated docs-map blocker is fixed?
rationale: The patch is technically plausible and proof-backed, but it intentionally changes provider auth/setup behavior and overlaps active Google Vertex work, so automation should not decide the product contract.

options.title: Accept This Contract After Docs Repair
options.body: Fix the generated docs map and accept the permissive ADC setup, request-time invalid-ADC failures, and onboarding-written defaults as the Google Vertex product contract.

options.title: Narrow Before Merge
options.body: Keep or narrow the old auth gate/default behavior and reduce setup writes to the minimum maintainers want onboarding to own.

options.title: Pause Behind The Vertex Cluster
options.body: Use this PR as proof and defer landing until the broader Google Vertex issue and competing PR direction are settled.

recommendation.title: Accept This Contract After Docs Repair
recommendation.body: Fix the generated docs map and accept the permissive ADC setup, request-time invalid-ADC failures, and onboarding-written defaults as the Google Vertex product contract.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the strongest available maintainer-routing signal from current source history and release-adjacent Google provider work.
